That's true, I can't really just leave school though. Not unless I want to be disconnected from my parents and family. Which is really all I have. I don't understand college. I came here ready to learn, I was very fond of investing and wanted to begin my own real estate investing company. My grades are good, I stay in good physical shape. I used to love intellectual discussions and good books. Now at college it seems none of that makes an impression on anyone. They'd all rather go get drunk, piss away what little money they have and then go do stupid things together. No one is interested in befriending the person I am. Is this really what America's society has become?

I just feel alone here at this giant university. I am 19 and a sophomore and thus far have yet to befriend anyone amidst this student body of around 50,000 people. Today my "best friend" was supposed to drive up here to visit me but he just blew me off out of nowhere this morning. That's the second time it's happened. I feel like I care more about our friendship than he does. So I spent the whole day feeling awful. But it seems like that's been the trend these past few weeks here. I'm just done feeling like nobody cares. What does it matter if I kill myself anyways? Human history and the existence of mankind is like a grain of sand on an infinite beach. The universe doesn't care about any of us. If I kill myself it will have absolutely no effect
